criteria.description: (R-1) `from app_int.main import square` succeeds, and `square` is a callable defined in src/app_int/main.py.
(R-3) square(3) == 9, square(1) == 1, and square(12) == 144, and each result is an int.
(R-7) `square.__annotations__` contains an entry for 'n' and an entry for 'return'.
(R-8) At least one test function under tests/ imports `square` from `app_int.main` and asserts its result for a positive integer, a negative integer, and zero.
(R-9) The existing tests test_health_check_reports_ok and test_add_returns_the_sum are still present and pass, and health_check() == {'status': 'ok'} and add(2, 3) == 5.
(R-11) `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
(R-12) The `dependencies` list in the [project] section of pyproject.toml is unchanged (still empty).
